- **Brown the meat before it goes in.** A quick sear adds a flavor layer the slow cooker can't create on its own. Your stew would get noticeably better.
- **Don't lift the lid.** Every peek costs a lot of heat; it's the classic reason things take forever.
- **Cut ingredients to similar sizes** so everything finishes at the same time.
- **Use less liquid than you think.** The sealed lid traps steam, so stovetop amounts turn into soup.
- **Dairy and fresh herbs go in at the end**, or they curdle / flatten out.
- **Layer wisely:** root veg at the bottom (slowest to cook), meat in the middle, delicate things on top.
